self_intersection_screen.method: Exhaustive X sweep plus Y/Z AABB overlap; normalized plane sidedness; noncoplanar triangle-plane segment interval overlap; coplanar dominant-plane GEOS polygon intersection. Only exact-position shared-simplex contacts accepted.
limitations: Double-precision floating-point and GEOS predicates with the declared tolerance; not exact arithmetic or a formal proof.
Geometry within tolerance may be merged in the predicates. Nearly parallel ambiguity is a finding, never silently counted as a pass.

normal_chord_thickness_screen.method: One inward normal ray from every original triangle centroid; origin offset inward by 1e-05 mm; brute-force Moller-Trumbore nearest positive hit against every original triangle, source face excluded.
limitations: Finite centroid samples measure normal chord length, not the global minimum wall thickness; edge and vertex tips can be thinner.
Short chords at tapers, relief and corners are warnings; they do not automatically establish unprintability.
No extrusion width, toolpath, material, nozzle, bridge or print outcome is modeled.

overhang_support_screen.orientation: As delivered, base at z=0 on the build plate.
overhang_support_screen.method: Every downward-facing original triangle whose normal lies within 45 degrees of -Z, excluding triangles wholly on z=0. Vertical -Z ray from centroid records the first lower surface and air gap. This is an overhang screening metric, not support generation.
limitations: A downward face over a gap may be bridgeable; a vertical ray does not decide whether support is necessary.
Triangle-centroid rays can miss the worst point and do not evaluate bridge span, support access/removal, cooling, adhesion or deformation.
No formal slicer run, G-code review or physical print test was performed.
